description: This file defines the template class 'absl::uniform_real_distribution' for generating uniformly distributed floating-point random numbers over a specified interval. It includes class definitions, methods for parameter handling, and input/output stream operators.

classes.name: absl::uniform_real_distribution
classes.description: Template class for generating uniform floating-point random numbers over [a, b).

classes.name: absl::uniform_real_distribution::param_type
classes.description: Parameter class holding interval bounds for the distribution.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Generates a random number using the distribution and a provided generator.

methods.name: a
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the interval.

methods.name: b
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the interval.

methods.name: param
methods.description: Gets or sets the distribution parameters.
